correctness.rationale: Directly proving the constant terms in the generator images vanish gives a 12-parameter description. Tensor square action produces the explicit 4-by-4 matrix. A cyclic 2-by-2 normal form proves characteristic-dependent tensor ranks. Block rank addition via kernel-to-cokernel projection and elementary 2-by-2 matrix counts yields every multiplicity; the formulas sum exactly to q^12. Independent Gaussian elimination exhausts all 4096 maps over F2 and all 531441 over F3, checks all 2-by-2 leading matrices over F2,F3,F4,F5, and samples higher-field quadratic parameters with independent Leibniz checks. Finite tests support, but are not substituted for, the all-prime-power proof.

value.rationale: The algebra is the universal two-generator associative local algebra of radical nilpotency three and maximal quadratic layer, a canonical minimal test object for infinitesimal symmetries of noncommutative Artin algebras. The theorem gives the entire operator-rank stratification, exposes a sharp maximal-rank collapse from six to four in characteristic two despite unchanged 12-dimensional derivation parameter space, and provides exact counts for all q. This is a structural characteristic-dependent phenomenon, not a reparameterized known rank of a single derivation or an arbitrary finite slice. Higher truncations and richer automorphism representation problems naturally require knowing these lowest-degree rank strata.
